mapper.insert: insert into log_operation_record (event_id, trace_id, request_id, user_id, username, dept_name, title, business_type, api_path, request_method, controller_method, client_ip, client_location, user_agent, request_params, response_body, http_status, exec_status, error_message, cost_time_ms, occurred_at, created_at) values (#{eventId}, #{traceId}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{deptName}, #{title}, #{businessType}, #{apiPath}, #{requestMethod}, #{controllerMethod}, #{clientIp}, #{clientLocation}, #{userAgent}, #{requestParams}, #{responseBody}, #{httpStatus}, #{execStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{costTimeMs}, #{occurredAt}, now(3))
mapper.select: select id, event_id as eventId, trace_id as traceId, request_id as requestId, user_id as userId, username, dept_name as deptName, title, business_type as businessType, api_path as apiPath, request_method as requestMethod, controller_method as controllerMethod, client_ip as clientIp, client_location as clientLocation, user_agent as userAgent, request_params as requestParams, response_body as responseBody, http_status as httpStatus, exec_status as execStatus, error_message as errorMessage, cost_time_ms as costTimeMs, occurred_at as occurredAt from log_operation_record where event_id > #{eventId} order by event_id asc limit #{limit}
